body.name: Admissible endpoint-response class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak E_s=\{(D_p,f):D_p\subset\mathbb R^d\text{ is a known nonempty compact uniformly convex body with }C^{s+2}\text{ boundary-chart norm at most }L\text{ and principal curvatures in }[L^{-1},L];\ \int_{D_p}f(y)\,dy=1,\ b\le f\le B,\ \lVert f\rVert_{C^s(D_p)}\le L;\ (\nabla\varphi_f)_{\#}\mu_0=f(y)\,dy,\ \int_\Omega\varphi_f=0,\ \lVert\varphi_f\rVert_{C^{s+2}(\Omega)}\le L,\ mI_d\preceq D^2\varphi_f\preceq MI_d\}\), with the same Holder/classical convention as \(\mathcal M_s\).
